landing.heroBody: Search, book and talk over video call in one place, with every step paid through secure escrow.
landing.aboutBody1: Some questions can't be answered by searching the internet, and chatbots don't go deep enough. Advisory Platform connects you with real, identity-verified experts.
landing.aboutBody2: Search, book, chat, video call and pay, all in one app. No switching between tools.
landing.statPaymentValue: Held until the job is done
landing.step1Body: Pick a category or search a topic
landing.step2Body: Choose an open time and pay
landing.step3Body: Talk in the app, chat and share files
landing.step4Body: Only then is the payment released
landing.know1Body: Everyone verifies their identity with a national ID and sends proof of expertise for our team to review before taking bookings.
landing.know2Title: Payment is held until the consultation ends
landing.know2Body: The system holds your payment, then releases it to the expert once the consultation is complete. If something goes wrong, you can request a refund.
landing.know3Body: Added on top of the expert's price and shown clearly before you pay, every time.
landing.know4Body: Your data is kept in line with the PDPA, and you can ask for your whole account to be deleted at any time.
landing.faqSubtitle: What most people want to know before their first consultation
landing.faq1Question: How do I book a consultation with an expert?
landing.faq1Answer: Choose an expert you're interested in, look at their open times, then book and pay. A video-call room is created automatically and you'll get a reminder before your appointment.
landing.faq2Question: How much does a consultation cost?
landing.faq2Answer: Experts set their own prices. Right now they start at ฿600 for 30 minutes and go up to around ฿1,800 for 90 minutes. The price on the card is for the whole session. The 5% platform fee is added and shown separately before you pay.
landing.faq3Question: Is payment safe? How does escrow work?
landing.faq3Answer: Card details are encrypted and tokenised by Omise. We never store card numbers ourselves. Once a booking is confirmed, the money is held in the system and doesn't reach the expert until the consultation is complete.
landing.faq4Question: How do I know an expert is really qualified?
landing.faq4Answer: Everyone verifies their identity with a national ID and attaches proof for every skill they offer. Our team reviews it before a profile is published. The Verified badge on a card means both checks were passed.
landing.faq5Question: What can I get advice on?
landing.faq5Answer: Six fields are open right now: business, finance, law, education, wellbeing and technology. If you're not sure which one fits, describe your problem briefly and let the system match you with an expert.
landing.faq6Question: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
landing.faq6Answer: Yes. Because your payment is held until the consultation ends, if it doesn't go as agreed you can file a refund request. Our team will review it and return the money to the way you paid.
landing.faq7Question: How is Advisory different from hiring a consultant?
landing.faq7Answer: You pay per session for the time you actually use. No contract and no monthly retainer. Book one hour to ask one thing, then come back and book again whenever you need.
landing.faq8Question: How do I become an advisor?
landing.faq8Answer: Apply from the menu in the app: fill in your details, verify your identity, then list your skills with proof for each. Our team will review it and let you know the result.
